texts390.text: A tiny endless runner with a big appetite.
A quick escape, one jump at a time.
Press Space or ↑, or tap to jump. Time it right to clear the clutter.
Each little wedge adds 25 points. A little courage goes a long way.
The pantry gets quicker as you go. Your best stays in this browser.
A spot for your little victories
Finish a run to set the first score.
Browser scores only. No global rankings.
Made for one more little run.
